# Flowtide.NET

> Flowtide is a .NET streaming SQL engine. This repository contains the engine, connectors, acceptance tests, samples, and documentation.

The documentation site maintains the canonical LLM index. This repository entry point links to that reference and the guides in this checkout.

## Documentation

- [Published LLM index](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms.txt): Start here for building streams, Flowtide SQL, expressions, connector contracts, testing, and operations.
- [Complete application reference](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms-full.txt): All four application guides combined into one generated file.
- [Index in this checkout](docs/llms.txt): Repository copy of the published index.
- [Stream guide in this checkout](docs/llms/streams.txt): C# application examples, state, hosting, and testing.
- [SQL guide in this checkout](docs/llms/sql.txt): Supported SQL, analytic functions, recursion, and time windows.
- [Expression catalog in this checkout](docs/llms/expressions.txt): Implemented operators, functions, signatures, and limitations.
- [Connector guide in this checkout](docs/llms/connectors.txt): Source/sink registration and required data contracts.
